episode_definition.start: first completed prospective effective month with NG3 state ARMED
episode_definition.same_episode: consecutive completed effective months with state ARMED
episode_definition.close: first completed effective month with state IDLE after an ARMED run
episode_definition.reopen: an ARMED month after at least one completed IDLE effective month starts a new episode
episode_definition.anchor: last trading day of first ARMED effective month
episode_definition.missing_month_bridge: ARMED -> missing effective month(s) -> ARMED remains one episode; record continuity_evidence_gap=true and missing_effective_months.
episode_definition.missing_month_conservative_bias: Unknown monthly state may not be used as evidence that an episode ended.

outcome_tracking.completed_horizon_immutability: Once a horizon has complete=true, its stored metrics are frozen and must not be recomputed from a later rolling price window.

promotion_review.rule: When four complete 252-session prospective episodes without continuity evidence gaps exist, only set review_eligible=true. A separate decision record is required for any promotion.
promotion_review.continuity_gap_rule: A completed episode with continuity_evidence_gap=true is retained in the ledger but excluded from review_eligible episode count.

source_provenance.snapshot_requirement: Every prospective snapshot records cryptographic SHA-256 fingerprints for the Fama-French ZIP vintages, credit payloads/extension snapshot, and SPY payload used to compute the state.
source_provenance.episode_start_requirement: Each new episode permanently stores source_provenance_at_start copied from the opening snapshot.
source_provenance.purpose: Prevent later upstream revisions or rolling API windows from changing the identity of the evidence vintage.

monthly_signal_immutability.lock_rule: For effective_month >= 202612, the first successful snapshot produced after that month is complete becomes the canonical signal snapshot for that effective month.
monthly_signal_immutability.later_revisions: Later scheduled runs may update forward outcome observations, but must not overwrite the frozen monthly signal state, score, gates, source months, or source fingerprints.
monthly_signal_immutability.failure_behavior: If required inputs are stale or unavailable, no monthly snapshot is frozen; the workflow retries on a later scheduled run.
monthly_signal_immutability.purpose: Preserve true prospective point-in-time evidence against later upstream revisions.
